I’ve been dealing with transmission issues on my 2015 Chevy Tahoe since 2021, when I first had the transmission replaced. Over the past 4 years, my truck has been in and out of the shop more than 20 times, each visit lasting 2 to 4 weeks. Despite all this, the transmission continued to slip while stopped and shift hard from 3rd to 2nd gear.
I was repeatedly told:

The torque converter was bad—it’s been replaced over 10 times.
The issue was due to bad mechanics, but I was assured a new tech would resolve it.
I dealt with 4 different individuals and multiple techs across both locations.

Three weeks ago, I dropped my truck off again and spoke with the person I’ve been working with for the past two years. After a week, I was told my vehicle had not been serviced properly under warranty. I was shocked—how could that be after so many visits and torque converter replacements? I was told it didn’t matter. After a 30-minute discussion, he agreed to fix the issue but said he wouldn’t make money from the repair and asked me to help pay. I refused, and he finally agreed to fix it—but said my warranty would be void.
I picked up my truck this past Saturday. I was told a mechanic would ride with me to confirm the fix—that didn’t happen. Then I was hit with a $510 charge for the TCM, which apparently wasn’t covered by the warranty. I asked to speak to the owner multiple times and was refused. I was told, “Don’t contact us again.”
To top it off, every time I picked up my truck, it was returned with an empty gas tank—even this last time. When I asked about it, I was told, “How did you think cars drive? They need gas.” Unbelievable.
I have messages and written statements backing up everything I’ve said, including one that reads:

“Wow, you’ve been very patient with us. I would probably handle things differently if I were in your shoes.”

I’ve tried to be respectful and patient. All I ever wanted was a properly functioning transmission—not 4 years of frustration and financial burden.
I wonder if the owner will reach out to discuss, if not.. oh well.. lesson learned from me. Even though I was treated like trash, I won't lower my standards and mention all names that were involved.

Stay away from this place specially if you are a WOMAN!  I took my 2012 Dodge Journey to this place because the gears weren’t working properly. I left it on May 13,2025 so they could do a proper diagnostic and let me know what I was looking at. Took them over a week to get me a quote and that’s because I had to go in person because no one would bother calling me back. I spoke to Gabe twice & assured me he would return my call, lair. They said my car needed the solenoid replaced and quoted me $800. They also said it would take 2-3 days max as it was considered a “Minor repair”. After I agreed that same day May 20th. I was supposed to pick it up ready to go Tuesday after Memorial Day. Wasn’t ready. Again I had to go in person to find out what the hold up was. Was told they had made the replacement but couldn’t get my car to turn on. Then later that week I was told they got it to turn on but the parts they had just installed must had been bad because it wasn’t working properly still that they were waiting on another new set. THEN it turned out that the transmission was still giving them problems and was told they needed to take it out, open it & see what was going on. After weeks of having it there I was told the transmission needed to be replaced and was given a quote of $2400. I said NO, i want it put back how it was. I had to tow my truck back home when I actually DROVE IT MYSELF TO THEM. They gave it back to me IN MUCH WORSE SHAPE than when I left it. Now it won’t drive forward only on reverse. I would urge you to stay AWAY from this place. They don’t keep their word, they give you the run around & end up messing up your vehicle more than how it is when dropping it off. My car is home now (June 5th) and not drivable.

I took my vehicle to this place and instead of fixing it they messed it up... they didn't wanna fix the problem anymore with my transmission... they told me it was LIFETIME WARRANTY!!! That was a lie!!!

I took my vehicle back 3x to see if they could repair the problem it had and i was told that they couldn't fix the problem anymore because they had it in the shop 3x... my transmissions went from bad to worse... so yeah I got hustled... over 2000 dollars I paid to get hustled...

A two to three day total rebuild took over two weeks of my time and Uber costs. Contract stated that all new gaskets and other parts would be new and text messages support this. My mechanic discovered silicone on all of the gaskets. They attempted to cut a cross bar under the front of the transmission instead of removing 4 bolts. Fluid was leaking from the front seals, the back seals and the transmission pan. High temperature silicone was used on my exhaust system because they used all of my old gaskets. I had only driven 1500 miles in town for a six month period. We were going to go to Arkansas in this car, a 2007 Lexus LS460 with 142,000. To be fair they said that they completely rebuilt my transmission after I showed them what my mechanic found. I haven’t had any issues since the rebuild but I will have my mechanic check everything when I change my oil. They wanted me to remove my review but everything stated above is true and that’s what a review is for.
